name: tagspaces-browser-extension
description: Codebase for TagSpaces' Web Clipper extension available for Chrome, MSEdge and Firefox

scripts.safari-xcode: yarn build-safari && xcrun safari-web-extension-converter build/safari --project-location safari-xcode --app-name "TagSpaces Web Clipper" --bundle-identifier org.tagspaces.webclipper --swift --no-open && sed -i '' 's/CODE_SIGN_STYLE = Automatic;/CODE_SIGN_STYLE = Automatic;\n\t\t\t\tDEVELOPMENT_TEAM = "";/' "safari-xcode/TagSpaces Web Clipper/TagSpaces Web Clipper.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj"
scripts.package: yarn clean && yarn build && yarn patch-version && yarn pack-chrome && yarn pack-firefox
scripts.update-i18n: ./tx pull -a -d && cd _locales && cp de_DE/* de && cd ..
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
